MODULE 1: DATA INGESTION & CORPUS MANAGEMENT
3.1 Understanding the News API
API Endpoint: https://newsapi.org/v2/everything
Key Parameters:

q: Search query (e.g., "Tesla", "merger", "stock market")
apiKey: Your API key
language: Set to "en"
sortBy: Use "publishedAt" for chronological order
pageSize: Maximum 100 articles per request
page: For pagination (starts at 1)
from: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD format)
to: End date (YYYY-MM-DD format)


3.2 MongoDB Schema Design
Database Name: nexus_db
Collection Name: articles
Document Structure:
python{
  "_id": ObjectId,  # Auto-generated by MongoDB
  "article_id": "unique_hash_string",  # MD5 hash of URL
  "publication_date": ISODate("2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"),
  "source": "Reuters",
  "headline": "Article title here",
  "full_text": "Complete article content...",
  "url": "https://...",
  "author": "John Doe",  # Optional, can be null
  "created_at": ISODate("2024-01-16T12:00:00Z")  # When ingested
}
3.3 Implementation Instructions for Module 1
File: src/module1_ingestion/config.py
Purpose: Load and manage configuration
What to implement:

Load environment variables using dotenv
Create constants for:

NEWS_API_KEY
NEWS_API_BASE_URL = "https://newsapi.org/v2/everything"
MONGODB_URI
MONGODB_DB_NAME
MONGODB_COLLECTION_NAME


Create a function validate_config() that checks all required variables are set
Raise an error with a clear message if any are missing

Error handling: If any config is missing, print which variable is missing and instructions to set it in .env

File: src/module1_ingestion/db_handler.py
Purpose: Handle all MongoDB operations
Create a class MongoHandler with these methods:
__init__(self):

Load config from config.py
Initialize MongoDB client using pymongo.MongoClient()
Get reference to database and collection
Do NOT connect yet (lazy connection)

connect(self):

Establish connection to MongoDB
Test connection with a ping command: self.client.admin.command('ping')
Print success message
If connection fails, print error and instructions to check MongoDB URI

article_exists(self, article_id):

Check if an article with this article_id already exists
Return True or False
Use: self.collection.find_one({"article_id": article_id})

insert_article(self, article_dict):

Before inserting, check if article exists using article_exists()
If exists, return False and log "Article already exists: {article_id}"
If not exists, insert using self.collection.insert_one(article_dict)
Return True on success
Handle any exceptions (network errors, etc.) and return False

get_article_count(self):

Return total number of articles in collection
Use: self.collection.count_documents({})

get_all_articles(self, limit=None):

Fetch all articles from MongoDB
If limit is provided, only fetch that many
Return as list of dictionaries
Use: self.collection.find().limit(limit) if limit, else self.collection.find()

close(self):

Close MongoDB connection
Use: self.client.close()

Important notes:

Add logging to every method (print statements are fine for now)
Handle the case where MongoDB is not reachable gracefully
Always use try-except blocks for database operations


File: src/module1_ingestion/news_api_client.py
Purpose: Interact with News API
Create a class NewsAPIClient with these methods:
__init__(self, api_key):

Store the API key
Store the base URL from config
Initialize a requests.Session() for connection pooling

_make_request(self, params, max_retries=3):

Private method to make HTTP GET requests with retry logic
Add apiKey to params
Make request to NEWS_API_BASE_URL
Set timeout to 30 seconds
Handle these errors:

Status 401: Print "Invalid API key" and raise exception
Status 429: Print "Rate limit exceeded, waiting 60 seconds", wait, retry
Status 500+: Print "Server error, retrying", wait 10 seconds, retry
Network errors: Print error, retry


After max_retries, raise exception
Return JSON response on success

fetch_articles(self, query, page=1, page_size=100, from_date=None, to_date=None):

Build params dictionary:

python  params = {
      "q": query,
      "language": "en",
      "sortBy": "publishedAt",
      "page": page,
      "pageSize": page_size
  }

Add from and to dates if provided
Call _make_request(params)
Extract articles from response: response['articles']
Return list of article dictionaries
Log how many articles were returned

fetch_all_articles_for_query(self, query, max_articles=1000, from_date=None, to_date=None):

Fetch multiple pages until you have max_articles or no more results
Start with page=1
Loop:

Call fetch_articles() with current page
If no articles returned, break
Add articles to results list
Increment page
If total articles >= max_articles, break
Add small delay (1 second) between requests to respect rate limits


Return collected articles
Log progress: "Fetched page X, total articles: Y"

Important notes:

Always log API calls (which query, which page)
Handle the case where the API returns an error in the JSON (check for status: "error" in response)
Respect rate limits by adding delays


File: src/module1_ingestion/ingestion_service.py
Purpose: Orchestrate the ingestion process
Create a class IngestionService with these methods:
__init__(self, news_client, db_handler):

Store references to NewsAPIClient and MongoHandler instances

_transform_article(self, raw_article):

Transform News API format to your MongoDB schema
Extract:

article_id: Generate using MD5 hash of the URL



python    import hashlib
    article_id = hashlib.md5(raw_article['url'].encode()).hexdigest()

publication_date: Parse from publishedAt field (already in ISO format)
source: Get from raw_article['source']['name']
headline: Get from raw_article['title']
full_text: Get from raw_article['content'] if exists, else raw_article['description'], else empty string
url: Get from raw_article['url']
author: Get from raw_article['author'] if exists, else None
created_at: Current timestamp (use datetime.utcnow())
Return dictionary matching your MongoDB schema
Handle missing fields gracefully (use .get() method with defaults)

ingest_articles_for_query(self, query, max_articles=1000):

Use news_client.fetch_all_articles_for_query() to get articles
For each raw article:

Transform using _transform_article()
Try to insert using db_handler.insert_article()
Track statistics: total fetched, successfully inserted, duplicates skipped, errors


Return statistics dictionary:

python  {
      "query": query,
      "fetched": 150,
      "inserted": 120,
      "duplicates": 30,
      "errors": 0
  }

Log progress every 10 articles

ingest_multiple_queries(self, query_list, max_articles_per_query=500):

For each query in the list, call ingest_articles_for_query()
Collect all statistics
Return aggregate statistics
Add delay between queries to respect rate limits (5 seconds)


File: src/module1_ingestion/main.py
Purpose: Main script to run ingestion
What to implement:

Import all necessary classes
Load configuration
Create instances of NewsAPIClient and MongoHandler
Connect to MongoDB
Define a list of financial search queries:

python   FINANCIAL_QUERIES = [
       "merger acquisition",
       "stock market",
       "IPO",
       "earnings report",
       "CEO resignation",
       "partnership deal",
       "investment funding",
       "bankruptcy",
       "regulatory approval",
       "market trends"
   ]

Create IngestionService instance
Run ingestion for each query (start with max 100 articles per query for testing)
Print detailed statistics after completion
Print final article count in database
Close connections

Script structure:
pythonif __name__ == "__main__":
    # Setup
    # Connect
    # Run ingestion
    # Print stats
    # Cleanup
```

**Important:** Add error handling at the top level to catch any unexpected errors

---

### 3.4 Module 1 Completion Checklist

Before moving to Module 2, verify:
- [ ] You can successfully connect to MongoDB
- [ ] A single News API call works and returns articles
- [ ] Articles are being transformed correctly
- [ ] Articles are being stored in MongoDB with correct schema
- [ ] Duplicate articles are being prevented
- [ ] You have at least 200-300 articles stored in MongoDB
- [ ] All errors are being logged
- [ ] The script can run multiple queries sequentially

**How to verify:** 
1. Check MongoDB Atlas web interface to see stored articles
2. Count documents in collection
3. Manually inspect 2-3 articles to verify all fields are correct
